name: Priestbane (Magic Weapon Quality)
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 8th; Price +1 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

Priestbane weapons were developed for fighting clerics and other servants of the gods who wield magic. Against enemies capable of casting divine spells, the weapon’s enhancement bonus is +2 better than its actual bonus. It also deals an extra 2d6 points of damage to them.

A creature capable of casting divine spells takes a -1 penalty to concentration checks when holding a priestbane weapon.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Mage Slayer
